title: What is the average amount of credit card withdrawals made in 1998 by accou
question: What is the average amount of credit card withdrawals made in 1998 by accounts located in districts where the unemployment rate increased by more than 5% from 1995 to 1996 and that have monthly statement issuance?

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(T4."XCL_051")
FROM card AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1."XCL_006" = T2."XCL_013"
INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2."XCL_015" = T3."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN trans AS T4 ON T3."XCL_001" = T4."XCL_047"
INNER JOIN district AS T5 ON T3."XCL_002" = T5."XCL_017"
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T4."XCL_048") = '1998'
  AND T4."XCL_050" = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND (T5."XCL_029" - T5."XCL_028") / T5."XCL_028" > 0.05
  AND T3."XCL_003" = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
